notes: Isolated neutron star cooling constraint on QCD axion. Main result is an upper limit on the axion mass (ma < 16 meV KSVZ, 95% CL). In a model with only axion-neutron coupling they constrain |g_ann| < 1.3e-9; with only axion-proton |g_app| < 1.5e-9 (95% CL). Encoded the neutron coupling bound as a mass-independent (flat) horizontal line using the [0,g] sentinel since the coupling limit is quoted as a single value. Paper also has a g_ann-g_app exclusion plane (Fig S5) and a DFSZ ma vs tan-beta plot (Fig 3). Coupling type ambiguous between neutron/proton; chose AxionNeutron per guidance.
